title: Chapter 164: Sneaking Into The Village
content:
Chapter 164: Sneaking Into The Village

Several bandits kneeling on the ground, covered in mud and with ferocious expressions on their faces, echoed: "The Fourth Master died so miserably, avenge the Fourth Master!"

"Revenge for the fourth master!"

The other bandit leaders also roared angrily.

At this time, a discordant voice sounded.

"Master, please calm down. Now that a wall has been built in Wana Village, it is really not conducive to our attack. This matter needs to be discussed in the long run!"

A young man with fine features stood up and tried to dissuade him.

"Yuanjie doesn't need to say anything. If I don't avenge my fourth brother, what face do I have as the head of the family? Since my brothers trust me and respect me as their lifelong brother, I must conquer Wana Village and avenge my dead brothers."

This person seems to be impulsive, but he is not completely brainless. What he looks like now is just for his brothers to see.

Revenge is true, but it cannot be done on impulse!

Several of his bosses and some of the bandit leaders were all promoted by him, and they still have deep feelings for them.

Zou Yuanjie guessed the master's thoughts and knew that this matter had to be done, so he could only sigh helplessly.

In his memory, he was a man who had read poetry and books, but he accidentally fell into the hands of bandits. Zhang Wenlong saw that he was a scholar and admired him quite a lot, and made him a military advisor, which was how he entered the world. Qualifications of the Chamber.

Naturally, he couldn't understand the brotherly relationship between the heads of the family.

Now that the boss has made up his mind, he can only try his best to plan!

Suddenly, the bandit who was originally guarding the mountain, Jiang Yingyu, walked into the meeting hall.

"Report to the boss, I captured a few people from a caravan at the foot of the mountain."

With that said, he presented the golden treasure chest.

When everyone saw the golden treasure chest, they were all stunned.

They had never seen a gold chest since their robbery.

After opening the treasure chest, the golden coins inside blinded everyone's titanium alloy eyes.

In the quiet hall, the sound of swallowing can be heard.

Zhang Wenlong took a look and saw that there were at least nearly 10,000 gold coins inside.

Wang Shuo managed to get this together from the grocery store.

Wang Shuo's original stock of gold coins was very small, and most of his recent transactions had been using energy crystals. After simply prescribing prescriptions to the people in the grocery store, everyone used gold coins to buy a lot of supplies, and finally collected 10,000 gold coins.

At this time, Jiang Yingyu continued: "Master, there are only a few of us, and we were not able to eat all the caravans. The main force of the caravans escaped by them. Among the goods they transported, there were also a large number of gold coins."

"Are you serious?" At this time, Zhang Hong, the second master with a pair of red and phoenix eyes, screamed in surprise. His eyes were shining, and the greed in his eyes was not concealed at all.

"Returning to the Second Master, everything my subordinates say is true."

"Brother, let me take some people and go get them all back!"

"The boss, I'll go too!"

"I want to go too!"

Suddenly, the other bandit leaders saw this and were eager to try, and started shouting one after another.

Even one of the men guarding the mountain could snatch back tens of thousands of gold coins, and other bandit leaders were naturally ready to take action.

"Okay, let the second child go for a trip this time." Zhang Wenlong was also in a good mood. Looking at the gold treasure box in his hand, even the grief of the fourth child's death eased a lot.

"Young men, who would like to come with me?" Zhang Hong, the second master, raised his arms and immediately a group of bandit leaders followed him and walked out of the hall.

Only Military Advisor Zou Yuanjie smiled bitterly and shook his head gently.

As for Gong Zheng and others, they were imprisoned.

The bosses didn't take it seriously.

This was not the first time they had arrested someone and taken them to the mountain. They would wait a few days to get through their temper, and then write a letter back asking for a ransom. If they didn't, they would kill them directly.

If he has any use value, let him join the gang and become a bandit.

After a while, the bandits, led by Zhang Hong, walked down the mountain in a hurry.

The mountain road is rugged, but they have been walking on this road all year round. Now they feel like they are walking on flat ground and their steps are as fast as flying.

Soon we arrived at the foot of the mountain.

Wang Shuo and others lurked above the trail, feeling relieved as they watched the bandits filing out.
